title: Send a message
summary: Write and send a text message to someone you know.

steps.title: Open WhatsApp
steps.instruction: Find and open WhatsApp on your phone.

steps.title: Open the chat
steps.instruction: Tap the name of the person you want to message. Check the name at the top.

steps.title: Write your message
steps.instruction: Tap the message box near the bottom and type your message.

steps.title: Review it
steps.instruction: Read the message once to check that it says what you mean.

steps.title: Send it
steps.instruction: Tap the send arrow. The message is sent only after you tap it.

title: Reply to a message
summary: Reply to one message in a chat so the other person knows what you mean.

steps.title: Open the chat
steps.instruction: Open the WhatsApp chat that contains the message.

steps.title: Choose the message
steps.instruction: Touch and hold the message you want to answer.

steps.title: Choose Reply
steps.instruction: Tap Reply when the menu appears. The selected message should appear above the typing box.

steps.title: Write your answer
steps.instruction: Tap the typing box and write your reply.

steps.title: Send
steps.instruction: Check the reply, then tap the send arrow.

title: Send a voice message
summary: Record a short voice message and send it in a chat.

steps.title: Open the chat
steps.instruction: Open the chat with the person you want to contact.

steps.title: Find the microphone
steps.instruction: Look beside the message box for the microphone icon. If you see a camera or plus icon instead, find the microphone in the attachment or message controls.

steps.title: Start recording
steps.instruction: Press and hold the microphone. If your phone asks for microphone permission, allow it only if you want to record.

steps.title: Speak clearly
steps.instruction: Say your message close to the phone. Keep it short and pause if you need to.

steps.title: Review or cancel
steps.instruction: If a preview is shown, listen to it. Use the delete or cancel control if you do not want to send it.

steps.title: Send
steps.instruction: Release the microphone or tap the send control, depending on what your screen shows.

title: Send a photo or file
summary: Choose a photo or document and send it to a WhatsApp chat.

steps.title: Open the chat
steps.instruction: Open the chat with the person who should receive the item. Check the name at the top.

steps.title: Open attachments
steps.instruction: Tap the paperclip or plus button beside the message box.

steps.title: Choose the item type
steps.instruction: Choose Photos or Gallery for a picture. Choose Document for a file.

steps.title: Select the item
steps.instruction: Find and tap the photo or file you want to send.

steps.title: Check the preview
steps.instruction: Make sure the preview shows the item you meant to send and the correct chat.

steps.title: Send
steps.instruction: Tap the send arrow. Do this only if you are happy to share the item with this person.

title: Make a voice call
summary: Start an audio call with a WhatsApp contact.

steps.title: Open the chat
steps.instruction: Open the chat with the person you want to call.

steps.title: Check the contact
steps.instruction: Check the name at the top so you call the right person.

steps.title: Tap the phone icon
steps.instruction: Tap the phone receiver icon near the top of the screen.

steps.title: Allow microphone access
steps.instruction: If your phone asks, allow microphone access only if you want to speak on the call.

steps.title: End the call
steps.instruction: When you are finished, tap the red end-call button.

title: Make a video call
summary: Start a video call with a WhatsApp contact.

steps.title: Open the chat
steps.instruction: Open the chat with the person you want to call.

steps.title: Check the contact
steps.instruction: Check the name at the top before starting the call.

steps.title: Tap the video icon
steps.instruction: Tap the video camera icon near the top of the screen.

steps.title: Allow camera and microphone
steps.instruction: If your phone asks, allow camera and microphone access only if you want to use video and sound.

steps.title: Adjust your camera
steps.instruction: Point the camera where you want the other person to see. You can turn the camera off with the on-screen control.

steps.title: End the call
steps.instruction: Tap the red end-call button when you are finished.

title: Share your location
summary: Share a location with a contact. Check the recipient and sharing duration first.

steps.title: Open the chat
steps.instruction: Open the chat with the person you intend to share your location with.

steps.title: Open attachments
steps.instruction: Tap the paperclip or plus button beside the message box.

steps.title: Choose Location
steps.instruction: Tap Location. If asked, allow location access only if you choose to continue.

steps.title: Choose what to share
steps.instruction: Choose a one-time current location or live location. Live location can continue sharing for a period of time.

steps.title: Check recipient and duration
steps.instruction: Check the contact name and, for live location, the sharing duration. Do not share if you are unsure.

steps.title: Send if you choose
steps.instruction: Tap the send control only if you want that person to see the location.

title: Find a chat
summary: Find a conversation by looking through chats or using search.

steps.title: Open WhatsApp
steps.instruction: Open WhatsApp and go to the Chats screen.

steps.title: Use search
steps.instruction: Tap the search icon or search box near the top.

steps.title: Enter a name
steps.instruction: Type the person's name or a word from the conversation.

steps.title: Check the result
steps.instruction: Read the name shown in the result list to make sure it is the right person.

steps.title: Open the chat
steps.instruction: Tap the matching result to open the conversation.

title: Create a group
summary: Start a group chat after checking who will be included.

steps.title: Open new chat
steps.instruction: On the Chats screen, tap the new chat button.

steps.title: Choose New group
steps.instruction: Tap New group in the list of options.

steps.title: Select people
steps.instruction: Tap the names of people you want to include. Check each name carefully.

steps.title: Continue
steps.instruction: Tap the arrow or Next button when the selected names are correct.

steps.title: Name the group
steps.instruction: Enter a group name that members will recognize.

steps.title: Create the group
steps.instruction: Review the members and group name, then tap Create.

title: Write and send an email
summary: Write a new email and check the recipient before sending.

steps.title: Open Gmail
steps.instruction: Open the Gmail app or website.

steps.title: Start a message
steps.instruction: Tap Compose, usually shown with a pencil or plus button.

steps.title: Enter the recipient
steps.instruction: Type the email address in the To field. Check every part of the address.

steps.title: Add a subject
steps.instruction: Tap Subject and write a short description of the email.

steps.title: Write your message
steps.instruction: Tap the message area and type what you want to say.

steps.title: Review and send
steps.instruction: Check the recipient, subject, and message. Tap Send only when they are correct.

title: Reply to an email
summary: Reply to the sender of an email you received.

steps.title: Open the email
steps.instruction: Open the message you want to answer.

steps.title: Choose Reply
steps.instruction: Tap Reply, usually below the message or in its menu.

steps.title: Write your reply
steps.instruction: Type your response in the reply area.

steps.title: Check the recipient
steps.instruction: Make sure the reply is going to the person you intend.

steps.title: Send
steps.instruction: Read your reply once more, then tap Send.

title: Forward an email
summary: Send a received email to another person after checking its contents and recipient.

steps.title: Open the email
steps.instruction: Open the message you want to forward.

steps.title: Choose Forward
steps.instruction: Tap Forward, usually in the message menu or below the email.

steps.title: Enter the recipient
steps.instruction: Type the email address of the person who should receive it.

steps.title: Review the contents
steps.instruction: Check the forwarded message and attachments. Remove anything you do not want to share.

steps.title: Send
steps.instruction: Check the recipient again, then tap Send if you want to share it.

title: Attach a file to an email
title_ur: ای میل کے ساتھ فائل لگائیں
summary: Add a document or photo to an email before sending it.

steps.title: Compose an email
steps.instruction: Tap Compose and enter the recipient and subject.

steps.title: Open attachments
steps.instruction: Tap the paperclip icon near the top of the screen.

steps.title: Choose where the file is
steps.instruction: Choose Attach file for a document, or Insert from Drive if the file is stored there.

steps.title: Select the file
steps.instruction: Find the file and tap it once. Wait for it to finish attaching.

steps.title: Confirm the attachment
steps.instruction: Check that the file name appears in the email and that it is the file you intend to share.

steps.title: Review and send
steps.instruction: Check the recipient and message. Tap Send only when you are ready.

title: Find an email
summary: Search for an email by sender, subject, or a word in the message.

steps.title: Open Gmail
steps.instruction: Open Gmail and find the search box near the top.

steps.title: Tap search
steps.instruction: Tap the search box.

steps.title: Enter a search word
steps.instruction: Type a sender name, email address, subject, or word you remember.

steps.title: Review results
steps.instruction: Check the sender and subject shown in each result.

steps.title: Open the right email
steps.instruction: Tap the result that matches the email you want.

title: Download an email attachment
title_ur: ای میل کی منسلک فائل ڈاؤن لوڈ کریں
summary: Save an attachment from an email you trust.

steps.title: Open the email
steps.instruction: Open the email with the attachment.

steps.title: Check the sender
steps.instruction: Make sure you recognize the sender and expected this file. If unsure, ask the sender using a contact method you already trust.

steps.title: Check the file name
steps.instruction: Look at the file name and type. Do not open an unexpected file.

steps.title: Download
steps.instruction: Tap the download icon beside the attachment if you want to save it.

steps.title: Find the saved file
steps.instruction: Open your phone's Files or Downloads app and look for the file.

title: Handle a suspicious email
summary: Pause and check an email before opening links, files, or sharing information.

steps.title: Pause before acting
steps.instruction: Do not rush because a message says your account is in danger or demands immediate action.

steps.title: Check the sender
steps.instruction: Read the full sender address. A familiar display name can still hide an unfamiliar address.

steps.title: Watch for sensitive requests
steps.instruction: Do not send a password, PIN, or one-time code by email or through a link in the message.

steps.title: Verify separately
steps.instruction: If it claims to be from a bank or company, contact that organization using a number or website you already trust.

steps.title: Report or delete
steps.instruction: If you believe it is unwanted or fraudulent, use Gmail's Report spam or Report phishing option. Ask someone you trust if you are unsure.
